show.description: A humble man who appears to be a simple egg seller but is secretly a trillionaire with immense power. After being mistreated and falsely accused by a wealthy socialite, he is saved by Vidya, a delivery girl who is also a widow facing abuse from her own greedy in-laws . Their lives intertwine when they are forced into an arranged marriage
